correct_completion: the team returned to their desks.
full_sentence: The meeting over, the team returned to their desks.
acceptable_variants: the team went back to work.
everyone headed back to their desks.

options.text: the team will return to their desks.
options.why_wrong: The future tense conflicts with the completed meeting described in the absolute clause, which places the event in the past.
This introduces an unrelated passive event that does not follow naturally from the meeting ending.

options.text: the team returned to their desks.
the team returning to their desks.
options.why_wrong: This gives only a participle phrase, so no finite verb forms a main clause to complete the sentence.

grammar_focus: Absolute clauses: a noun phrase followed by a participle or verbless structure, with the main clause in the past tense
explanation: The opening phrase is an absolute clause with its own subject and no finite verb. The main clause that follows needs a past tense verb and a subject, so that the time sequence is clear.
translation: Збори закінчилися, і команда повернулася до своїх столів.
